name: Xavian Water Sample
summary: At Xavian, ancient waters hold arcane power sought by Horde mages in Orgrimmar. They seek it to unravel the latent magic preserved in Ashenvale's oldest sacred sites.

sections.title: Waters of the Ancient City
sections.body: Xavian was a fabled ancient elven city, and its old knowledge remains known among the learned. Even in ruin, its waters are said to hold great magical power. Deino, an arcane instructor in Orgrimmar, sends rising mages deep into Ashenvale to draw fresh water from the pool beneath Xavian's tallest waterfall. They must cross dangerous ground, for corrupt satyrs now guard the ruins fiercely and oppose spellcasters who meddle there.

faq.q: Where is the water sample collected?
aliases: where do I get xavian water
how to get xavian water sample
faq.answer: Fill Deino's Flask at the pool beneath the tallest waterfall in Xavian's ruins. The site lies in northeastern Ashenvale, north past the lakes beyond Splintertree Post and Satyrnaar.

faq.q: Why does Deino want this water?
faq.answer: Deino, an arcane instructor in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, wants the water for her studies of potent and unusual magic. She teaches young Horde practitioners and seeks the ancient magical essence held in Xavian's undisturbed waters.

faq.q: What threats guard the waters of Xavian?
faq.answer: Satyrs inhabit the ancient elven ruins and fiercely defend their ground from curious mages. Aggressive beasts, including river crocolisks, also live in the surrounding waterways.

faq.q: What happens once the sample is returned to Orgrimmar?
aliases: what is the water used for
faq.answer: When the sample returns to Orgrimmar, Deino begins studying its arcane properties at once. She uses the gathered magic to advance her research and help train and instruct Horde mages.

angles.text: As a Horde mage, retrieving the sample tests your skill with natural arcane power and your ability to cross hostile, demon-tainted ground.
As a member of the Horde, you can see how gathering Xavian's ancient arcane resources aids Orgrimmar's scholars as the Horde strengthens its presence around Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.
